faq.q: Why hire an eCommerce Account Manager with dedicated OnBuy experience?
faq.a: OnBuy operates with unique catalog matching rules, Boost marketing structures, and Buy Box criteria distinct from Amazon or eBay. Having 2+ years of dedicated OnBuy experience means you avoid costly trial-and-error, capitalize on the platform's lower commission fees, and capture UK market share rapidly.

faq.q: How does your Psychology background benefit my eCommerce business?
faq.a: E-commerce is ultimately human decision-making at scale. My psychology education at Virtual University allows me to optimize listing copy for buyer cognitive fluency, eliminate purchase anxiety, manage angry customers calmly, and lead virtual assistant teams with high motivation and zero turnover.

faq.q: What is your typical onboarding process for a new client?
faq.a: We begin with a comprehensive 360° Account & Health Audit, analyzing listing indexing, pricing competitiveness, defect history, and profit margins. Then I deliver a 30-60-90 day growth roadmap, set up daily monitoring SOPs, and begin execution.

faq.q: Can you manage accounts across multiple marketplaces simultaneously?
faq.a: Yes! I specialize in cross-platform synergy across OnBuy, eBay, and TikTok Shop, ensuring synchronized inventory feeds, consistent brand messaging, and risk-diversified revenue streams.
